comment: Link-status reports `10 NN 41 04 <status> <wpid_lo> <wpid_hi>` fed to rf_spi with no configured slot. Status bit 0x40 = link lost. Measured on the bench: hub log 'link up (slot 2, status 0x87, wpid 4021)', remote log '(slot 1, status 0x07, wpid 880b)'. 'slot' is what the transport must report afterwards (-1 = not learned), 'attached' its link state.

vectors.name: hub lost before any up learns nothing
remote lost before any up learns nothing
hub slot 0 is not a remote
hub re-link on another slot is picked up
remote re-link on another slot is picked up
second remote cannot hijack a live link
another slot's loss does not detach
